description: This file manages system sound effects, including listing available sounds, retrieving sound URLs, and playing sounds using NSSound. It defines catalogs of sound names, internal methods for discovering sound files, and a player to handle sound playback with security considerations.

classes.name: SoundEffectPlayer
classes.description: A singleton utility enum for managing sound playback, including playing sounds from names or bookmarks, with internal state for the last played sound.

methods.name: systemOptions
methods.description: Returns a list of all discoverable system sound names, with 'Glass' as the first item, sorted case-insensitively.

methods.name: displayName(for:)
methods.description: Returns the display name for a given raw sound name, currently a direct pass-through.

methods.name: url(for:)
methods.description: Fetches the URL for a given sound name from the discovered sound map.

methods.name: sound(named:)
methods.description: Retrieves an NSSound object for a given sound name if available in system resources or via URL.

methods.name: sound(from:)
methods.description: Creates an NSSound from a security-scoped bookmark data.

methods.name: play(_:)
methods.description: Plays the given NSSound and updates the internal lastSound state.
